svg.aria-label: pdf-operations: PDF work through the existing pipeline. Merge, split, reorder, rotate and overlay with pdf-lib. Steps: Merge, many PDFs into one; Split, one PDF into its pages; Reorder, rotate, delete, duplicate; Overlay, text and shape stamps. Output: one clean PDF, no new pipeline written.
